itinerary.title: %3Cstrong%3EAlmaty%20Orientation%20Tour%3C/strong%3E%0A
itinerary.content: Embark on an enriching tour of Almaty, where the city unfolds before you in a seamless blend of history and modernity. As you stroll down the iconic Dostyk Avenue, Almaty’s evolution from a Soviet-era city to a contemporary metropolis is revealed against a backdrop of impressive architecture, cultural landmarks, and vibrant city life. Admire views of the Independence Monument and the Palace of the Republic, symbols of Kazakhstan’s sovereignty and cultural identity, while enjoying the scenic beauty of the breathtaking Alatau Mountains.This carefully curated journey offers a panoramic experience of Almaty’s urban elegance and natural charm, combining heritage, modern attractions, and picturesque surroundings into an unforgettable city experience.

itinerary.title: %3Cstrong%3EVisit%20Panfilov%20Park%20&%20Zenkov%20Cathedral%3C/strong%3E%0A
itinerary.content: Explore the historical heart of Almaty with a visit to Panfilov Park, a serene green space dedicated to the heroes of the Great Patriotic War. Enjoy the playful activity of feeding the hundreds of friendly pigeons that flock around the grounds. Nestled within the park, the striking Zenkov Cathedral stands as one of the world's tallest wooden buildings, remarkable for its intricate architecture and vibrant colors. This excursion offers a perfect blend of natural beauty, historical significance, and architectural marvel, making it a must-visit for an enriching and picturesque experience.

itinerary.title: %3Cstrong%3EVisit%20Botanical%20Garden%3C/strong%3E%0A
itinerary.content: Stroll through Almaty's Botanical Garden, a lush oasis showcasing a rich collection of flora from around the globe. This tranquil haven offers a peaceful escape in every season, with vibrant blooms in spring and summer, and a serene snowy landscape in winter. Perfect for families and nature enthusiasts, the garden invites visitors to explore its themed sections, picnic areas, and scenic paths, making it a year-round destination for discovery and relaxation.

itinerary.title: %3Cstrong%3EVisit%20Almaty%20Zoo%3C/strong%3E%0A
itinerary.content: Discover the historic Almaty Zoo, established in 1937, a captivating attraction for visitors of all ages. With its diverse collection of global wildlife and educational exhibits, it's an ideal destination for families year-round. This sanctuary of nature and conservation offers a unique journey through the animal kingdom, making it a must-visit for anyone eager to explore the wonders of the natural world in the heart of Kazakhstan.

itinerary.title: %3Cstrong%3ESunset%20Splendor%20at%20Kok%20Tobe:%20Almaty's%20View%20from%20Above%3C/strong%3E%0A
itinerary.title_search: Sunset Splendor at Kok Tobe: Almaty's View from Above
itinerary.content: Experience the enchantment of Almaty from its highest point at Kok Tobe, where the sunset views are unparalleled. Reach the summit by a picturesque cable car ride, offering a preview of the panoramic vistas that await. As the sun dips below the horizon, watch the city light up in a kaleidoscope of colors, against the backdrop of the majestic mountains. Kok Tobe isn't just about the views; it's a place of leisure and delight. Wander through the park, enjoy amusement rides, and explore unique attractions like The Beatles monument. Dine at the summit's restaurants, where the local and international cuisine tastes better with the sunset spectacle.Join us for a sunset visit to Kok Tobe, where every moment is a picture-perfect experience, blending natural beauty with the charm of Almaty's skyline at dusk.

itinerary.title: %3Cstrong%3EDay%20Excursion%20to%20Huns%20Ethno%20Village%20–%20A%20Journey%20into%20Kazakh%20Culture%3C/strong%3E%0A
itinerary.title_search: Day Excursion to Huns Ethno Village – A Journey into Kazakh Culture
itinerary.content: Discover the essence of Kazakhstan at Ethno Village, Almaty, where tradition meets the beauty of nature. Immerse yourself in the rich heritage of the Kazakh people, from the comfort of traditional yurts to the rhythm of folk music and dance. Engage in ancient crafts, archery, and savor the authentic flavors of Kazakh cuisine. This living museum offers a unique educational experience, revealing the customs and practices of a vibrant culture. Perfect for culture enthusiasts and nature lovers alike, Ethno Village is an unforgettable journey into the heart of Kazakhstan’s traditions. Join us to explore, learn, and be inspired.

itinerary.title: %3Cstrong%3EEnjoy%20a%20traditional%20Kazakh%20lunch%20at%20the%20Ethno%20Village%3C/strong%3E%0A
itinerary.title_search: Enjoy a traditional Kazakh lunch at the Ethno Village
itinerary.content: Enjoy a traditional Kazakh lunch in the authentic setting of the Ethno Village, featuring local specialities, freshly prepared dishes and traditional tea. Experience the warmth of Kazakh hospitality while dining in a culturally rich and traditional atmosphere

itinerary.title: %3Cstrong%3EJourney%20Back%20to%20Almaty%20From%20Ethno%20village%3C/strong%3E%0A
itinerary.title_search: Journey Back to Almaty From Ethno village
itinerary.content: The journey back to Almaty from the Ethno Village offers a scenic drive through picturesque landscapes, where modernity meets tradition. As you leave behind the immersive cultural experience of the village, the road winds through open fields, charming countryside views, and distant mountains. This transition back to the city is the perfect time to reflect on the rich heritage you've witnessed while soaking in the natural beauty of Kazakhstan, gradually returning to the vibrant urban life of Almaty.

itinerary.title: %3Cstrong%3EExcursion%20To%20Shymbulak%20Mountain%20&%20Ski%20Resort -%20Level%203%20Gondola%3C/strong%3E%0A
itinerary.title_search: Excursion To Shymbulak Mountain & Ski Resort - Level 3 Gondola
itinerary.content: Nestled amidst the breathtaking Tien Shan Mountains, Shymbulak Ski Resort is a year-round destination offering unforgettable experiences for travelers of all ages. Renowned for its world-class ski slopes, scenic hiking trails, panoramic gondola rides, and diverse dining options, the resort seamlessly blends adventure with relaxation. From cozy mountain lodges to one of the world's highest hotels, situated at 3,200 meters above sea level, Shymbulak provides spectacular alpine views and exceptional hospitality, making it an ideal getaway for families, nature lovers, and adventure enthusiasts alike.

itinerary.title_search: Walking tour of Panfilov & Arbat Streets
itinerary.content: A walking tour of Arbat Street and Panfilov Promenade in Almaty offers a delightful blend of culture and relaxation. Arbat Street, known for its vibrant atmosphere, features local artisans, street performers, and quaint shops, providing a lively introduction to the city’s creative side. Just a short walk away, Panfilov Promenade offers a peaceful stroll surrounded by greenery, historic monuments, and a glimpse of daily life in Almaty, making it a perfect spot to unwind and soak in the local charm.

itinerary.title_search: Day Excursion to Kolsai Lakes & Charyn Canyon From Almaty
itinerary.content: Discover the natural splendor of Kolsai Lakes and Charyn Canyon on a day excursion that caters to all ages. These stunning destinations offer more than just breathtaking landscapes and outdoor adventures; they are complemented by charming restaurants, bars, and cafes nearby, providing delicious culinary experiences amidst nature's wonders. Ideal for families and explorers, this journey combines the thrill of exploration with the pleasure of gastronomy, ensuring a memorable experience in any season.

itinerary.title: %3Cstrong%3EJourney%20back%20to%20Almaty%20City%20from%20Charyn%20Canyon%3C/strong%3E%0A
itinerary.title_search: Journey back to Almaty City from Charyn Canyon
itinerary.content: Leaving Charyn Canyon behind, we journey back to Almaty city, carrying memories of our adventure. The scenic drive offers a peaceful transition from the natural wonders back to urban comforts, marking the perfect end to an unforgettable day.

itinerary.title: %3Cstrong%3EExcursion%20to%20Issyk%20Lake%3C/strong%3E%0A
itinerary.content: Embark on a half-day excursion to Lake Issyk, located near Almaty, and experience a journey through picturesque countryside and lush landscapes. As you leave the city, the road winds through rolling hills and quaint villages, offering glimpses of rural life before revealing the majestic Tian Shan mountains. Upon arrival at Lake Issyk, you'll be greeted by serene turquoise waters set against a backdrop of towering peaks and dense forests. Enjoy leisurely walks, photography, and picnics by the lakeside, and explore the area's historical significance with ancient Scythian artifacts. The scenic drive back to Almaty completes this refreshing escape into nature's tranquility.

itinerary.title: %3Cstrong%3EExcursion%20to%20Almarasan%20Gorge%20+%20Ayusai%3C/strong%3E%0A
itinerary.content: The Almarasan Gorge, located near Almaty, offers visitors a lush and scenic escape with flowing rivers and ample hiking opportunities. This favorite spot is perfect for outdoor activities such as picnicking, trekking, and photography, providing a serene retreat into nature just a short distance from the city. Complementing this natural wonder, the Ayusai Visitor Center in Ile-Alatau National Park provides an engaging experience with exhibits on local flora and fauna, guided tours, and trails leading to the picturesque Ayusai Waterfalls. Visitors can enjoy wildlife watching, educational workshops, and school programs focused on environmental conservation. The center is involved in research and community conservation efforts. Amenities include a café, rest areas, and a gift shop, making it a perfect destination for nature enthusiasts and educational field trips. Together, Almarasan Gorge and the Ayusai Visitor Center offer a comprehensive nature experience, combining recreation, education, and breathtaking beauty.

itinerary.title: %3Cstrong%3EA%20Journey%20of%20Senses:%20Green%20Bazaar%20and%20Rahat%20Chocolate%20Shop%3C/strong%3E%0A
itinerary.title_search: A Journey of Senses: Green Bazaar and Rahat Chocolate Shop
itinerary.content: Embark on a vibrant excursion to Almaty's heart, where the Green Bazaar awaits to envelop you in a kaleidoscope of colors, aromas, and the bustling energy of local life. This is not merely a market; it's a cultural immersion, a place where every aisle and stall tells a story of tradition, community, and the richness of Kazakh gastronomy. The air is thick with the scent of spices, fresh herbs, and the spirited chatter of vendors and shoppers, creating an atmosphere of warmth and belonging. Just a stone's throw from this lively market scene, the Rahat Chocolate Shop offers a sweet transition from the vivaciousness of the bazaar. Stepping into Rahat is like entering a realm of nostalgic delight, where the scent of rich, melting chocolate wraps around you, evoking memories of joy and comfort. The shop showcases an array of beautifully crafted chocolates and confections, each piece a testament to the artistry and heritage of Kazakh sweets. The excursion to the Green Bazaar and Rahat Chocolate Shop is more than a journey through a market or a visit to a confectionery; it's an emotional voyage that connects you to the heart and soul of Almaty. It's about the joy of discovering new flavors, the pleasure of warm encounters, and the sweetness of moments that linger like the taste of fine chocolate. Together, these experiences embody the essence of Almaty's vibrant culture, offering a glimpse into the local way of life that is both enriching and profoundly touching.

itinerary.title: %3Cstrong%3EShopping%20Experience%20in%20Almaty%3C/strong%3E%0A
itinerary.content: Embark on a modern shopping tour of Almaty, where contemporary retail therapy meets the sophistication of the city's most acclaimed shopping centers. Begin your journey at Dostyk Plaza, a beacon of luxury and style, offering an array of international brands and designer boutiques under one elegant roof. Continue to Mega Mall, where shopping is an experience, featuring a diverse selection of stores alongside entertainment options for a complete family day out. Lastly, don't miss Esentai Mall, the epitome of high-end shopping in Almaty, with its exclusive brands, gourmet dining, and a panoramic view of the city skyline from its terraces. This tour is designed for those who seek the finest in shopping, within the sleek and modern environments of Almaty's premier shopping destinations, making it a perfect blend of retail indulgence and leisure.

itinerary.title: %3Cstrong%3ETransfer%20to%20the%20Almaty%20Airport.%3C/strong%3E%0A
itinerary.content: As your holiday in Almaty draws to a close, we ensure a seamless and comfortable transition back to the airport. Reflect on the cherished memories of your visit as you are transferred through the city's scenic vistas one last time. Upon arrival at the airport, a warm see-off awaits, extending our heartfelt wishes for a safe journey home and the hope that Almaty has engraved itself in your heart, inspiring a return in the future. This farewell is our way of expressing gratitude and bidding you goodbye, until next time.
